# ipatool-kit-core

Low-level App Store client used by [`ipatool-kit`](https://crates.io/crates/ipatool-kit): bag fetch, SAP signing, login, purchase, and IPA download.

Most applications should depend on **`ipatool-kit`** instead of this crate directly.

```toml
ipatool-kit-core = "0.2"
```

Library target name: `ipatool_core`.
